title: Reciprocal rank fusion
summary: Merge several ranked lists of document ids into one ranking with reciprocal rank fusion, optional list weights and a fixed tie rule.

mutants.first_appearance_ties: Sorts by score only, so equal scores keep the order of first appearance and not the lower doc id first.
mutants.ignore_weights: Adds 1 / (k + rank) for every list and ignores the list weights.
mutants.no_length_check: Does not raise ValueError when the number of weights differs from the number of lists.
mutants.rank_from_zero: Counts ranks from 0, so the first document of a list adds 1 / k and not 1 / (k + 1).
